subject: Vendor setup and banking verification for Everleaf Health — next steps
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie.park@everleafhealth.com>; procurement@everleafhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup and banking verification for Everleaf Health — next steps

Hi Sophie — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and the three things we need to keep momentum: 

1) Preferred commercial path: you mentioned procurement typically uses PO for vendors over $50k/yr, but sometimes card for pilot projects. Can you confirm whether Everleaf will process an initial purchase order (PO) or pay by card for the pilot? If PO, please share the AP contact and any PO templates/required fields.

2) Vendor packet and tax forms: attaching the Redwood vendor packet (PDF) — it has our ACH form, insurance cert, and standard MSA link. Please send back the completed W-9 (or W-8 if non-US entity) and the banking details (ACH banking routing/account or wire instructions) the vendor team requires.

3) Portal vs marketplace: if your procurement team prefers the cloud marketplace path (AWS Marketplace/GCP Marketplace) we can enable purchase via marketplace listing; that typically shortens PO processing for some customers. If Everleaf wants that route, let me know and I’ll route to our partnerships team to confirm listing & billing timing.

Next steps I propose:
- Sophie / procurement: confirm PO vs card vs marketplace preference and send required AP contact + any PO template by EOD Tue.
- Sophie: complete and return attached W-9 and banking info or confirm you want Redwood to complete marketplace billing.
- Marissa: once we have W-9 and bank info, run vendor setup and share enrollment confirmation back to Everleaf.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet_20270517.pdf (vendor packet stub)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min follow-up with procurement if helpful.

— Vivek

Hi Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. Looping in procurement (procurement@everleafhealth.com) since they manage onboarding. A few notes from our side: 

• Procurement preference: for pilots under $25k we usually pay by card; for anything above that we request a PO. The pilot Budget Owner intends to start at ~$30k, so we will need a PO.

• AP contact & PO fields: Procurement, can you confirm the AP contact and the PO fields you need?

• Tax form: Everleaf is US-based — attaching our completed W-9 (everleaf_w9_20270517.pdf).

• Banking info: Procurement prefers vendors to complete Redwood's vendor packet and provide ACH routing/account details directly on your packet; we do not accept banking info via plain email for security. If you can provide a DocuSign version of the packet we’ll sign & return.

• Marketplace: We prefer not to go through AWS Marketplace for this engagement due to our internal billing cadence.

I’ve attached the W-9. Procurement — please advise on AP contact and next steps for generating the PO.

Thanks,
Sophie Park
Director, Product & Partnerships
Everleaf Health
sophie.park@everleafhealth.com

Attachments: everleaf_w9_20270517.pdf
